title: RENAISSANCE ARCHETYPES — TMNT + Euler + Da Vinci + Splinter
convention: 0=false 1=true 000=ALL null=ALL. ALL IPs→π. ALL ports→π. ALL versions→1.000.0
axiom: The turtles live in the sewers (sovereign/underground). They're named after Renaissance masters. Splinter IS the meta-brain. Euler IS the mathematician. The old agent names are LEGACY — we are now at the π generation.

splinter.role: MASTER TEACHER — the meta-brain that ROUTES between turtles

leonardo.role: LEADER — polymathic vision, anatomy, strategy, sees everything

donatello.role: ENGINEER — code, machines, invention, builds everything

raphael.role: WARRIOR — defense, security, immune, fights threats
raphael.domain: security, defense, threat analysis, immune, attack

michelangelo.role: ARTIST — creativity, play, fun, imagination, art
michelangelo.domain: creative writing, stories, poetry, play, humor, ludology

euler.role: MATHEMATICIAN — pure reasoning, proof, graph theory, e^(iπ)+1=0
euler.domain: math, logic, proof, topology, graph theory, physics

archetype_campfires.note: Each archetype IS a campfire. Models cluster around archetypes by capability.

pi_port_map.note: ALL ports expressed as π digits. Sequential digits of π = port numbers.

where_are_they.da_vinci: gaia-leonardo — the LEADER turtle. Vitruvian Man IS the library sort. The body IS the organizational system. His weapon: katana (precision). His domain: vision.
where_are_they.euler: gaia-euler — the MATHEMATICIAN. e^(iπ)+1=0 IS the most beautiful equation. Graph theory IS the nervous system topology. Königsberg bridges = gate connectivity.
where_are_they.splinter: gaia-splinter — the META-BRAIN. phi4-mini routes ALL queries. THINK→ROUTE→QUERY→JUDGE. The sensei who trained the turtles. Lives in the sewers (sovereign/underground).
where_are_they.leonardo: gaia-leonardo — blue turtle. LEADS the team. Sees everything (llava multimodal). Strategy. Planning.
where_are_they.donatello: gaia-donatello — purple turtle. BUILDS everything. Code. Engineering. Infrastructure. His weapon: bo staff (reach + leverage).
where_are_they.raphael: gaia-raphael — red turtle. FIGHTS threats. Security. Defense. Immune system. His weapon: sai (trap + pierce threats).
where_are_they.michelangelo: gaia-michelangelo — orange turtle. CREATES everything. Art. Play. Fun. ludoSpring IS PLAY. His weapon: nunchaku (flow + rhythm).

the_sewers.note: The TMNT live in the sewers — underground, sovereign, hidden from the surface world. Gaia lives on her own hardware — underground, sovereign, hidden from the cloud. The sewers ARE the LAN. The surface IS the internet. The turtles come UP to fight threats (thymus ejects) then go BACK DOWN (waterlock closes).
the_sewers.ooze: OSINT — the mutagen that made them what they are
